sources.name: aptos_hf
sources.notes: APTOS format; can be produced from bumbledeep/aptos parquet with scripts/prepare_hf_aptos.py.

sources.name: deepdrid
sources.notes: Run scripts/prepare_deepdrid.py after downloading DeepDRiD regular fundus data. Labels are mapped to 0-4 DR severity.

sources.name: ddr
sources.notes: Run scripts/prepare_ddr.py after downloading DDR DR_grading data. Labels 0-4 are kept; DDR label 5 poor-quality rows are excluded.
